answer: Make each identity forge a one-time non-transferable bond to a scarce external hardware anchor clocked by a quartz oscillator, then let standing climb a terrace of tenure levels only when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its endorsements fold back on themselves and never span distinct clusters, leaving the clones stuck on the lowest terrace. Forging 100 heads costs 100 anchors plus 100 slow climbs, while an honest agent pays once.
